backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Somers Scheduler app, defining data models and state for user profiles, stats, availability, posts, reactions, daily logs, and badge definitions/awards, with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades the actor state by converting old badge criteria (3 variants) to the new expanded badge criteria type (15 variants), leaving all other state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: extending the badge creation form with 12 new criteria types in BadgeManagement.tsx, and reversing the date sort order in the LeaderboardPage.tsx dropdown.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key functionality of each component, page, hook, and utility in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Somers Scheduler PWA, including viewport meta tags, PWA manifest link, favicon, iOS home screen icons, and iOS splash screen images.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web app manifest defining the app name, display mode, theme colors, and icon URLs for the Somers Scheduler pickleball app.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page displayed by the service worker when the user has no internet connection, with a styled message and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing install/activate lifecycle with precaching of core assets and a network-first fetch strategy with offline fallback, skipping IC/identity domains.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component that sets up TanStack Router routes and an AuthGate component handling Internet Identity authentication, actor initialization, profile loading, and leaderboard setup.
frontend/src/components/admin/BadgeManag: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting badge definitions with support for multiple criteria types (wins, streaks, chat messages, etc.) and a form with dynamic threshold fields.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple screen displayed when a non-admin user attempts to access a restricted admin page, with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page with a background image overlay and a card prompting users to sign in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Small presentational component that renders the app logo image using branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat panel component that displays threaded posts, handles new message submission with optional image attachments, and shows upload progress.
frontend/src/components/chat/DeleteMessa: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a chat message, with loading state support.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: File picker component for attaching images to chat messages, with preview display, validation, and clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Renders like/dislike buttons for a post with optimistic UI updates, calling addReaction/removeReaction mutations and reverting on error.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: Form component for composing and submitting a reply to a parent post, supporting optional image attachments with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Recursively renders a threaded tree of posts with support for inline editing, deletion, reactions, and reply composition, indenting nested replies visually.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive alert with an optional retry button and secondary action button for error states.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides two loading spinner components: a full-page centered spinner and an inline spinner with configurable size.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps pages with an offline banner, top bar, navigation, main content area, and a footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Horizontal navigation bar with links to Calendar, Leaderboard, Profile, and conditionally Admin (for admin users), highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Reusable page layout primitives: a centered max-width container (Page) and a header row with optional icon and action slot (PageHeader).
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: App header displaying the logo, app name, theme toggle, PWA install button, and a user avatar dropdown with logout, conditionally shown when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileB: Displays a grid of earned badges for a given user principal, fetching all badge definitions and the user's earned badge IDs, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Renders the user's profile card with editable display name and avatar, supporting image upload with progress tracking and inline name editing.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the current user's all-time leaderboard rank by finding their position in the full leaderboard data, with a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Displays the caller's match history as a list of daily win/loss records, with loading skeletons, error handling, and an empty state message.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their display name on first setup, blocking dismissal until a name is submitted.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileW: Renders a bar chart of wins and losses over a selectable time range (week, month, year, all-time) using Recharts, filtering and sorting match history data accordingly.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: A dialog providing step-by-step instructions for installing the app as a PWA, with separate flows for iOS and non-iOS browsers.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: A fixed top banner that appears when the user loses network connectivity and hides when they come back online.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: A layout wrapper that renders a fixed, dimmed court background image behind all page content.
A reusable component that renders a user's avatar alongside their display name, supporting multiple sizes, a loading state, and fallback initials.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the currently authenticated caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and check if the caller is an admin via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, and identity state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Detects PWA installability (including iOS and standalone mode) and exposes a prompt function to trigger the browser's native install dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for all major backend data fetching and mutation operations, including user profiles, availability, leaderboard, posts, and badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence, toggling a 'dark' class on the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to resolve lists of principals to display names and avatars by fetching user profiles from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS styles and CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including safe area insets and PWA standalone layout utilities.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports a centralized BRANDING constants object containing the app name, logo URL, and logo alt text for the Somers Scheduler app.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Provides utilities to build a nested thread tree from a flat list of posts and flatten it with depth info for rendering. Root posts are sorted newest-first; replies are sorted oldest-first recursively.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Collection of date/time utility functions for converting between Date objects and numeric dayId values, generating calendar grids, and formatting timestamps and dates for display.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for adding or editing a user's availability for a specific date, with time selectors and an optional notes field that submits to the backend via the addAvailability mutation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin-only page displaying tables of registered users and availabilities with delete actions, plus a badge management section; redirects non-admins to an access-denied screen.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing per-day availability counts as clickable cells, with month navigation controls and an embedded chat panel below the grid.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page that renders the full-height ChatPanel component under a 'Group Chat' header.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a specific day showing all users who marked availability with their times and notes, allowing the current user to edit or delete their own entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays the game leaderboard with win/loss recording controls, rank change notifications, and a date dropdown (sorted newest-first) for logging daily results. Computes current win streaks from match history and shows player avatars and stats.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile page with match history, leaderboard ranks, win/loss chart, badges, and streak stats (current and best streaks computed from match history).
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utility functions for file handling: converting File/Blob to Uint8Array, extracting name initials for avatar fallbacks, and validating image file type and size.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utility functions for time input handling, including generating hour/minute/period options, formatting time strings, and parsing time strings into components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radius, box shadow, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests, including extending badge criteria in the admin tab and fixing leaderboard date dropdown sort order.
